explicit_scope_boundary: The package proves the displayed weighted-path, finite-residue, fixed-word Gaussian-coordinate, unweighted angle non-torsion, exceptional two-letter, 795-column finite-grid, survivor-coding, pressure, arithmetic-groupoid, affine-germ, torus-character, Kummer, Cayley-pair, Nori-map, packet--parity, cyclic-transport, three-clock, signed fixed-content primitive-necklace, synchronized-CRT, formal-dilation, convergence-domain, and meromorphic-continuation theorems. The all-length Collatz--Machin rigidity statement remains a conjecture. The finite cycle scans end at odd-return period sixteen and are stated only at that range. The package does not assert termination of every positive Collatz orbit, construct the excluded tropical or prismatic interfaces, identify an unspecified crossed product with a groupoid completion, classify equilibrium states, construct a motivic Galois action, claim a result outside the certified arctangent grid, claim novelty or priority, or claim completion of the wider corpus project.
